# VOLAMP ELEKTRIKALS PRIVATE LIMITED
> Authorized distributor and wholesale stockist of electrical wires, industrial cables, and power distribution equipment in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, supplying certified power cables, building wires, switchgear, and earthing infrastructure across 28 states.

Volamp Elektrikals Private Limited is an Ahmedabad authorized distributor and wholesale stockist of genuine electrical wires, industrial cables, and switchgear (Polycab, Finolex, KEI, Schneider, L&T). Family electrical business legacy dating to 1964; company incorporated in 2021 (CIN: U31900GJ2021PTC122730 | GSTIN: 24AAICV0754B1ZO | GeM Verified Reseller & Wholesale Distributor).

## Product Categories & Standards
- [Wires & Cables](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/wire-cables): LT/HT XLPE armoured power cables, control cables, and flexible copper wires (IS 7098 Part 1/2, IS 1554, IS 694).
- [Switchgear & Power Distribution](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/switch-gears): Air circuit breakers (ACB), MCCBs, MCBs, DBs, and contactors from Schneider Electric and L&T / Lauritz Knudsen.
- [Cable Lugs & Terminals](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/lugs): Dowells heavy-duty tinned copper crimping lugs, aluminium tubular terminals, and bimetallic lugs.
- [Conduits & Raceways](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/conduit): Rigid FRLS PVC conduits, Class 4 hot-dip galvanized (GI) steel conduits, and fittings.
- [Cable Glands & Management](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/glands): Brass single and double compression weatherproof/flameproof cable glands and termination kits.
- [Industrial Wiring Devices](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/wiring-device): IEC 60309 industrial plugs & sockets, combination distribution boxes, and enclosed rotary isolators.
- [Earthing & Lightning Protection](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/earthing-material): Copper-bonded rods (UL/CPRI certified), chemical earthing compound (BFC), and GI earthing strips.
- [Solar & Renewable Cables](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/solar): 1500V DC solar PV cables (EN 50618 / IEC 62930), MC4 connectors, and solar array combiner boxes.

## Authorized Brand Partners & Core Lines
- [Polycab India](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=Polycab): Industrial LT/HT power cables, solar DC cables, and FRLS wires.
- [Finolex Cables](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=Finolex): Electrolytic copper building wires and industrial flexible cables.
- [KEI Industries](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=KEI): Heavy industrial power cables, rubber trailing cables, and HT distribution.
- [Schneider Electric](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=Schneider): Acti9, EasyPact MCCBs, contactors, and industrial protection switchgear.
- [L&T / Lauritz Knudsen](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=L%26T): dsine MCCBs, motor starters, and power distribution boards.
- [Dowells](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=Dowells): Heavy-duty copper terminal lugs and crimping accessories.
- [Legrand](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/products?brand=Legrand): Protection switchgear and industrial distribution enclosures.
